blocks.html:
WinTAK's drawing tools let you sketch plans — routes, areas and control measures — and share them with your unit through a feed.

Draft: written without screenshots. Add WinTAK drawing-tool screenshots when available.

slides.title: Open the drawing tools
slides.html: Open the drawing tools from the WinTAK toolbar. You can place lines, routes, shapes and freehand drawings directly on the map.

slides.title: Draw routes and areas
slides.html: Draw what the plan needs — a marching or patrol route, an area (polygon/circle) for a sector or objective, or control measures. Snap points onto the map and adjust them as needed.

slides.title: Label and style
slides.html: Give each drawing a clear name and set its colour so the plan reads at a glance and matches your unit's conventions.

slides.title: Share to a feed
slides.html: Send the finished plan to a Data Sync feed (for example a PLAN feed) so the whole unit receives it and stays in sync as you update it.
